inputs: SP 800-38A AES-128 first-block vectors for ECB, CBC, CFB, OFB and CTR
expected: All five ciphertexts match the NIST values; decryption/round-trip where applicable
limitations: One block per mode; checks the mode formula, not full-message protocol behavior.

inputs: NIST CAVP gcmEncryptExtIV128.rsp Count 0 (128-bit key, 96-bit IV, 128-bit plaintext, no AAD, 128-bit tag)
expected: Ciphertext 2ccda4a5415cb91e135c2a0f78c9b2fd and tag b36d1df9b9d5e596f83e8b7f52971cb3; authenticated decryption succeeds
limitations: One official test case; it does not exercise AAD, long messages or nonce management.

inputs: AES-128 with a repeated 16-byte plaintext block under ECB, CBC and CTR
expected: ECB produces identical ciphertext blocks; CBC and CTR do not
limitations: A structural demonstration, not an attack on AES or a statement about all plaintexts.

inputs: Two fixed plaintexts under the same AES-128 key and CTR nonce, then under different nonces
expected: Same-nonce ciphertext XOR equals plaintext XOR; different nonce breaks the relation
limitations: Arithmetic consequence of keystream reuse; it does not model a full protocol attack.

inputs: AES-128-CBC two-block ciphertext with one bit flipped in the first ciphertext block
expected: The first plaintext block is corrupted and the same bit of the second plaintext block flips
limitations: Shows CBC malleability, not a complete chosen-ciphertext attack.

inputs: The GCM test vector with a modified ciphertext and a modified tag
limitations: Checks tag verification behavior; it does not test every malformed-input path.

inputs: A 20-byte plaintext padded with PKCS#7 for AES-CBC and a 20-byte plaintext under CTR
expected: CBC input grows to 32 bytes with 12 bytes of padding 0x0c; CTR needs no padding and preserves length
limitations: Padding mechanics only; it does not test padding-oracle behavior.
